payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-26 (owner-approved page reads from the cloud session, no provider access): First batch, crisis and urgent lines first. The merged live catalogue has 247 records, 93 with no source URL (57 of them High confidence). Child Protection Central Intake is now a canonical record (SVC-CHP-001) sourced from the Department of Communities child-safety page (last updated 19 May 2026; hours not stated). The Women's Domestic Violence Helpline page was read (24 hours, 1800 007 339, last updated 14 January 2025) and captured in source-acquisitions.json but NOT written as a record: a verified record becomes the first usable family-violence match in service-urgent-routing.ts and displaces 1800RESPECT as the pinned route (services-safety-routing test), which is an owner decision. Next highest-risk unsourced records: Crisis Care and Child Protection Central Intake (S034, a duplicate), Crisis Resolution Home Treatment Team (S035), Kununurra Safe Place (S089), RAPID at RPH (S159/S160), YouthLink (S216), Youth-HITH (S212), YCATT (S210), and the metropolitan CMHS clinics. PRIOR DETAIL: RECHECKED 2026-09-25: no verification batch done. The cloud session's network egress refuses every publisher host (wa.gov.au, mhc.wa.gov.au, aihw.gov.au, ruah.org.au, youthfocus.com.au, passages.org.au, healthdirect.gov.au and others all returned connect_rejected on 2026-09-25), and the sources skill forbids taking a publisher, date or contact detail from anywhere but the publisher's own page, so this cannot be done from a cloud session. TO UNBLOCK: run it from an unrestricted network, for example a Remote Control session on the owner's PC, or have the owner approve each page fetch. Telephone confirmation and sign-off stay with the owner regardless. PRIOR DETAIL: Measured on data/services-snapshot.json, 2026-09-16: of 219 legacy service records, 100 carry no public source URL at all, 98 state no opening hours, and 100 were extracted from an earlier research document without ever being checked against a live page. Despite that, 159 are marked confidence High. Examples with no source link and High confidence: Armadale Community Mental Health Service, Bentley Older Adult, Butler CMHS, Child Protection Central Intake, and the Childbirth and Mental Illness Service at KEMH. The read-time ageing fix on this branch makes the deficiency visible rather than hiding it, because a record with no recorded review now reads as unknown instead of current, but it does not supply the missing evidence. A separate data error found while reconciling: the Mother and Baby Unit record (S115) conflates KEMH and Fiona Stanley into one entry, listing the Fiona Stanley number under a provider field naming both. NEXT: verify in risk order rather than alphabetically, per docs/services-mode-governance.md, taking crisis and urgent contacts first, then common referral routes, then descriptive content. Page checking and record drafting can be done per batch; telephone confirmation and sign-off cannot.
